init.title: Venice AI Options
init.description: Configure Venice AI settings. Every text model returned by Venice AI is listed.

data_description.chat_model: Chat model used for conversation. Every text model returned by Venice AI is listed. Device control needs a model that can call tools.
data_description.prompt: Instructions sent with every conversation. Home Assistant adds entity state and tool instructions.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant APIs this assistant may use to control devices. Leave empty to disable control.
data_description.temperature: Higher values make replies more varied. Range 0 to 2.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens in a single reply. Range 1 to 32768.
data_description.strip_thinking_response: Remove reasoning text from the spoken or displayed reply.
data_description.disable_thinking: Ask reasoning models not to use a thinking step.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: How many tool calls one turn may make. Range 1 to 20.
data_description.tts_model_voice: Speech model and voice, shown as model then voice.
data_description.stt_timestamps: Include word timestamps when the model supports them.
data_description.stream_response: Stream the reply as it is generated instead of waiting for the full response.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Venice AI
error.missing_api_key: No API key is stored for this entry. Reconfigure Venice AI and enter the key again.
error.invalid_tts_voice_for_model: The selected voice entry is invalid. Please select a valid 'Model → Voice' entry from the list.
error.invalid_llm_api: The selected Home Assistant control option is not available. Please choose a valid option or leave blank to disable.
error.max_tokens_out_of_range: Max tokens must be between 1 and 32768.
error.top_p_out_of_range: Top P must be between 0 and 1.
error.max_tool_iterations_out_of_range: Max tool iterations must be between 1 and 20.
error.tts_speed_out_of_range: TTS speed must be between 0.25 and 4.
error.prompt_must_be_string: The system prompt must be text.

config_entry.description: The Venice AI config entry to use for this service call.

model.name: Model
model.description: Image model id from the Venice image catalog. Not a video model, and not "default".

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio this model lists, such as 1:1 or 16:9. Models that do not list aspect ratios reject this field.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution this model lists, such as 1K or 2K. Models that do not list resolutions reject this field.

width.name: Width
width.description: Pixel width from 1 to 1280. Set with height, and only for models that size by pixels.

height.name: Height
height.description: Pixel height from 1 to 1280. Set with width, and only for models that size by pixels.
